mapper.select:
WITH RECURSIVE org_tree AS (
SELECT id_, name_, code_, parent_, 0 AS level_ FROM sys_org WHERE id_ = #{orgId}
UNION ALL
SELECT o.id_, o.name_, o.code_, o.parent_, 1 AS level_ FROM sys_org o INNER JOIN org_tree ot ON o.parent_ = ot.id_ WHERE ot.level_ = 0 -- 限制只查直接子组织 ),
org_scope AS ( SELECT target_org.id_ AS target_org_id, target_org.name_ AS target_org_name, descendant.id_ AS descendant_org_id FROM org_tree target_org INNER JOIN sys_org descendant ON descendant.code_ LIKE CONCAT(target_org.code_, '%') )
SELECT os.target_org_id AS orgId, os.target_org_name AS orgName,
COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN t.id_ IS NOT NULL AND t.audit_time IS NOT NULL THEN t.id_ END) AS opportunityCount,
COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN t.id_ IS NOT NULL AND t.audit_time IS NOT NULL THEN t.id_ END) AS newOpportunityCount,
COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN t.id_ IS NOT NULL AND t.audit_time IS NOT NULL AND DATE_FORMAT(t.audit_time, '%Y%m%d') BETWEEN #{leftTime} AND #{rightTime} THEN t.id_ END) AS newOpportunityCount,
COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN c.project_id IS NOT NULL AND c.audit_time IS NOT NULL THEN c.project_id END) AS signedOpportunityCount,
COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN c.project_id IS NOT NULL AND c.audit_time IS NOT NULL THEN c.project_id END) AS newSignedOpportunityCount,
COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN c.project_id IS NOT NULL AND c.audit_time IS NOT NULL AND DATE_FORMAT(c.audit_time, '%Y%m%d') BETWEEN #{leftTime} AND #{rightTime} THEN c.project_id END) AS newSignedOpportunityCount,
SUM(CASE WHEN t.designer IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS supportOpportunityCount,
SUM(CASE WHEN t.designer IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS newSupportOpportunityCount,
SUM(CASE WHEN t.designer IS NOT NULL AND DATE_FORMAT(t.designer_time, '%Y%m%d') BETWEEN #{leftTime} AND #{rightTime} THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS newSupportOpportunityCount,
COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN c.id_ IS NOT NULL AND c.audit_time IS NOT NULL THEN c.id_ END) AS contractCount,
COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN c.id_ IS NOT NULL AND c.audit_time IS NOT NULL THEN c.id_ END) AS newContractCount,
COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN c.id_ IS NOT NULL AND c.audit_time IS NOT NULL AND DATE_FORMAT(c.audit_time, '%Y%m%d') BETWEEN #{leftTime} AND #{rightTime} THEN c.id_ END) AS newContractCount,
IFNULL(SUM(CASE WHEN c.total_money IS NOT NULL THEN ROUND(c.total_money, 0) ELSE 0 END), 0) AS contractAmount,
IFNULL(SUM(CASE WHEN c.total_money IS NOT NULL THEN ROUND(c.total_money, 0) ELSE 0 END), 0) AS newContractAmount,
IFNULL(SUM(CASE WHEN c.total_money IS NOT NULL AND DATE_FORMAT(c.audit_time, '%Y%m%d') BETWEEN #{leftTime} AND #{rightTime} THEN ROUND(c.total_money, 0) ELSE 0 END), 0) AS newContractAmount,
IFNULL(SUM(t.expect_contract_money), 0) AS expectAmount
FROM org_scope os LEFT JOIN sys_user u ON u.org_id = os.descendant_org_id LEFT JOIN topp_opportunity_base_view t ON t.cust_manager_id = u.id_ AND t.opp_source <> 'kssj' AND t.audit_status NOT IN ('opp_notpass', 'opp_new')
AND t.opp_type IN
#{type}
LEFT JOIN topp_contract_base_view c ON c.project_id = t.id_ AND c.audit_status = 2 GROUP BY os.target_org_id, os.target_org_name ORDER BY os.target_org_id ASC
